skills.detail:
When Counter Succeeds:
If enemy attacks within a set period of time, deals a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect. Also, HP will be recovered.

When Counter Fails:
If the enemy does not attack within a set period of time, deals a mid-range area attack.

Become temporarily invincible after use.
